name: Ran Kirlian
bio: Ran Kirlian is an ambient musician and sound sculptor born in Hannover, Germany, in 1972 and based in Valencia, Spain. Self-taught, he began exploring music in the mid-1990s and released his first album, Shore of Darkness, in 2000. His work centers on tribal and dark ambient soundscapes, often grown from improvisations and refined over time, combining synthesizers and samplers with field recordings, flutes, percussion, bowls and didgeridoos.
